acceptance_criteria.condition: The Skill defines readability, ownership, contracts, dependency direction, explicit effects, atomic state transitions, and extension decisions without imposing arbitrary size limits or mandatory abstractions.
Applicable Level 1 and Level 2 changes record a design boundary, dependency audit, and extension decision, and the completion gate requires their review.
The README provides an accurate Chinese summary of recoverable atomicity, dependency direction, and evidence-based extension decisions.
The captured forward-test records show the Skill guiding agents to keep narrow boundaries, avoid speculative abstractions, and use recoverable multi-resource transitions.

invariants: The Skill remains dependency-free and does not require a project-wide architecture framework.
A direct implementation remains preferred over speculative abstraction.
No documentation rule may claim distributed writes are atomic without transaction or recovery evidence.

safeguards.name: ownership and contract review
safeguards.rationale: Applicable changes must state the owner, input/output contract, and state transition or side effect.

safeguards.name: dependency-direction audit
safeguards.rationale: The Skill prohibits unreviewed cycles, reverse-layer imports, shared mutable globals, and private-state reach-through.

safeguards.name: abstraction admission rule
safeguards.rationale: New seams need two independent consumers, a stable external contract, or a demonstrated testing boundary.

safeguards.name: recoverable multi-resource transition
safeguards.rationale: The Safeguard Matrix requires a transaction or explicit durable ordering, recovery, and compensation/outbox design.

design_boundary.rationale: The normative Skill owns readable, recoverable module boundaries and its documentation remains a summary.

dependency_audit.rationale: The policy explicitly reviews dependency direction, cycles, shared mutable state, and private-state reach-through.

extension_decision.rationale: The Skill keeps direct implementation by default and admits seams only for concrete consumers, stable contracts, or test boundaries.

data_ownership.rationale: This package policy change does not create or mutate application business or personal data.

error_model.rationale: This focused change adds structural guidance but does not change an application boundary's runtime error classification.

contract_evolution.rationale: This public Skill contract change preserves older evidence artifacts while adding new ledger guidance.

operational_budget.rationale: The structural policy update does not alter a measured service performance or resource path.

threat_boundary.rationale: The focused structural change does not expose or privilege an application operation.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: This focused structural policy change did not define a repository commit or PR workflow.

release_recovery.rationale: This focused structural policy change did not alter a deployable release or recovery path.

data_migration.rationale: This focused structural policy change did not migrate schema or business data.

configuration_secrets.rationale: This focused structural policy change did not alter configuration or credential handling.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: This focused structural policy change added no dependency or supply-chain control.

operational_knowledge.rationale: This focused structural policy change did not require an ADR or runbook.

reproducibility.rationale: This focused structural policy change did not change setup or environment reproduction guidance.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Captured qualitative scenarios covering direct implementation, contract boundaries, and transaction/outbox recovery.
Independent review findings and recorded remediations shared by the current related Skill changes.

verification.result: Skill package validation passed after the maintainability and metadata changes.
49 package tests passed after the later composite-trap extension; this package-wide run includes evidence, report reproducibility, quality-decision, and supporting-artifact coverage.
The regenerated Codex UI metadata and active workflow parsed as YAML.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert the Skill, README, agent metadata, validator, template, tests, captured evaluation artifacts, and this evidence artifact together. Existing project evidence remains compatible because quality_decisions and supporting_artifacts are optional schema extensions.

independent_review.notes: The related public Skill changes received an initial review, then a follow-up review confirming the evidence schema, hash-verified support artifacts, final-report coverage, risk-scaled metadata, and regression tests after remediation.

remaining_risks: The Skill guides review and evidence but cannot automatically discover every dependency cycle or architectural violation without project-specific static-analysis tooling.
Projects with an established architecture may require stricter local layering rules than this generic policy.
